def stage_basis_projection(path):
    """Stage explicit partial manifest anchors on the owned private copy.

    The ordinary sustained writer must fully replay this copy before accepting
    any answer. Staging alone is not source admission or publication. Existing
    native observations and all coordinates not entailed by closure survive.
    """
    from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.completion import _contexts, _entry
    from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.foundation import BANKS, load_manifest
    from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.resolution import resolve_dictionary
    from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.rule_migration import _refresh_catalog
    from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.storage import store_entry
    from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.validation import _observations, _stored_context

    manifest = read(BASIS_MANIFEST)
    _, requested, _ = load_manifest(BASIS_MANIFEST)
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(path)) as conn:
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        saved = conn.execute("SELECT value FROM builder_metadata WHERE key='checkpoint_basis_projection'").fetchone()
        if saved:
            receipt = json.loads(saved[0])
            if receipt["manifest_sha256"] != fingerprint(BASIS_MANIFEST):
                raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_BASIS_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
            return receipt
        relations = _relations(_metadata(conn, "relations"))
        anchors = _metadata(conn, "anchors")
        _, relevance = _contexts(conn, tuple(requested))
        changes = []
        with conn:
            for entry, records in requested.items():
                if len(records) != 1 or entry in anchors:
                    raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_BASIS_REQUIRES_NEW_PARTIAL_ANCHOR")
                [raw] = conn.execute(
                    "SELECT payload FROM source_observations WHERE entry_id=? AND source='nsm_chart'", (entry,)
                ).fetchall()
                observation = json.loads(raw[0])
                [declared] = records
                assertion = basis_assertion(entry, declared.bank, declared.value, observation)
                if asdict(assertion) != manifest["anchors"][entry][0]:
                    raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_BASIS_DECLARATION_CHANGED")
                definition, assertions, restrictions, hierarchy = _entry(conn, entry)
                before = json.loads(
                    conn.execute("SELECT domains FROM definition_states WHERE entry_id=?", (entry,)).fetchone()[0]
                )
                if len(before[assertion.bank]) != 3 or assertions:
                    raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_BASIS_NOT_UNASSERTED_CANONICAL_UNIT")
                resolution = resolve_dictionary(
                    BANKS,
                    (assertion,),
                    relations,
                    _stored_context(conn, definition, relations),
                    evidence_banks=tuple(sorted(relevance[entry])),
                    domain_restrictions=restrictions,
                )
                if resolution.code == "CONFLICT" or not all(
                    set(resolution.domains[bank]) <= set(values) for bank, values in before.items()
                ):
                    raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_BASIS_CONTRADICTION")
                store_entry(conn, definition, resolution, (assertion,), hierarchy, domain_restrictions=restrictions)
                anchors[entry] = [asdict(assertion)]
                changes.append(
                    {
                        "entry_id": entry,
                        "source": observation,
                        "assertion": asdict(assertion),
                        "before": before,
                        "after": {bank: sorted(values) for bank, values in resolution.domains.items()},
                    }
                )
            conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO builder_metadata VALUES ('anchors',?)", (json.dumps(anchors),))
            mismatches = []
            native, _, bank_relevance = _observations(
                conn,
                {row[0] for row in conn.execute("SELECT entry_id FROM definition_states")},
                lambda *args, **kwargs: mismatches.append((args, kwargs)),
            )
            if mismatches:
                raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_BASIS_NATIVE_SOURCE_MISMATCH")
            _refresh_catalog(conn, relations, native, bank_relevance)
            receipt = {
                "format": "GSE.checkpoint-basis-projection/1",
                "code": "STAGED_REQUIRES_FULL_WRITER_PREFLIGHT",
                "manifest_sha256": fingerprint(BASIS_MANIFEST),
                "changes": changes,
                "authority": "PRIMARY_NSM_IDENTITIES_AND_APPROVED_GSE_BIPOLAR_CORRESPONDENCE",
                "other_coordinates": "UNKNOWN_UNLESS_EXISTING_APPROVED_JOINT_CLOSURE_ENTAILS_THEM",
            }
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO builder_metadata VALUES ('checkpoint_basis_projection',?)", (json.dumps(receipt),)
            )
        return receipt

def _refresh_catalog(conn, relations, native, bank_relevance):
    from .catalog import catalog_report
    from .evidence import Definition

    anchors, models = _authorities(conn)
    lexemes = {row["id"]: row for row in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM lexemes")}
    links = _optional_metadata(conn, "prime_entries", {})
    if current_id(_metadata(conn, "catalog")["format"]) == "GSE.nsm-catalog-coverage/1":
        definitions = tuple(Definition(r["sense_id"], r["lemma"], r["pos"], r["gloss"]) for r in lexemes.values())
        catalog = catalog_report(anchors, definitions, relations, prime_entries=links)
    else:
        evidence, restrictions = defaultdict(list), defaultdict(list)
        for entry, ordinal, payload in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM builder_assertions"):
            evidence[entry].append((ordinal, payload))
        for entry, ordinal, payload in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM builder_domain_restrictions"):
            restrictions[entry].append((ordinal, payload))
        catalog = _native_catalog(
            anchors, relations, lexemes, links, models, evidence, restrictions, native, bank_relevance, conn=conn
        )
    conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO builder_metadata VALUES ('catalog',?)", (_json(catalog),))
    report = _refresh_coverage(conn)
    report.update(foundation_readiness=catalog["readiness"], prime_coverage=catalog["coverage_counts"])
    conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO builder_metadata VALUES ('last_report',?)", (_json(report),))

def _contexts(conn, selected, *, indexed=False):
    """Retain only selected payloads, with identical ordering on both paths."""
    observations, relevance = defaultdict(list), defaultdict(set)
    wanted = set(selected)
    if not wanted:
        return observations, relevance
    if indexed:
        parameters = ",".join("?" for _ in selected)
        rows = conn.execute(
            f"""SELECT observation.payload FROM source_observations observation
                JOIN (
                    SELECT record_id FROM source_observations WHERE entry_id IN ({parameters})
                    UNION
                    SELECT record_id FROM completion_context_targets WHERE entry_id IN ({parameters})
                ) target ON target.record_id=observation.record_id
                ORDER BY observation.record_id""",
            (*selected, *selected),
        )
    else:
        rows = conn.execute("SELECT payload FROM source_observations ORDER BY record_id")
    for (payload,) in rows:
        raw = _read_json(payload)
        targets = (raw["entry_id"],) if raw["entry_id"] is not None else raw["candidate_entry_ids"]
        matched = wanted.intersection(targets)
        if not matched:

            raw["source"],
            raw["record_id"],
            raw["family"],
            raw["features"],

        for entry in sorted(matched):

def _assertions(rows: list[tuple[int, str]]) -> tuple[Assertion, ...]:
    if any(type(ordinal) is not int or ordinal < 0 for ordinal, _ in rows):
        raise ValueError("INVALID_ASSERTION_ORDINAL")
    ordered = sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row[0])
    if [ordinal for ordinal, _ in ordered] != list(range(len(rows))):
        raise ValueError("MISSING_OR_DUPLICATE_ASSERTION_ORDINAL")
    required = {field.name for field in fields(Assertion)}
    result = []
    for _, payload in ordered:
        record = _read_json(payload)
        if not isinstance(record, dict) or set(record) != required:
            raise ValueError("INVALID_ASSERTION_FIELDS")
        result.append(Assertion(**record))
    return tuple(result)
def _domain_restrictions(rows) -> tuple[DomainRestriction, ...]:
    ordered = sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row[0])
    if any(type(ordinal) is not int for ordinal, _ in rows) or [ordinal for ordinal, _ in ordered] != list(
        range(len(rows))
    ):
        raise ValueError("INVALID_RESTRICTION_ORDINAL")
    result = []
    required = {field.name for field in fields(DomainRestriction)}
    for _, payload in ordered:
        record = _read_json(payload)
        if not isinstance(record, dict) or set(record) != required or not isinstance(record["allowed_values"], list):
            raise ValueError("INVALID_RESTRICTION_FIELDS")
        result.append(
            DomainRestriction(
                record["bank"],
                tuple(record["allowed_values"]),
                record["source"],
                record["record_id"],
                record["family"],
                record["scope"],
            )
        )
    return tuple(result)

def store_entry(conn, definition, resolution, assertions=(), hierarchy=None, *, domain_restrictions=()) -> None:
    """Replace one explicitly identified definition's complete build receipt."""
    hierarchy = hierarchy or {}
    if resolution.code == "CONFLICT":
        hierarchy = {}
    if any(bank not in resolution.assignments or resolution.assignments[bank] == 0 for bank in hierarchy):
        raise ValueError("HIERARCHY_REQUIRES_NONZERO_BASE")
    status = {"CONFLICT": "rejected", "PARTIAL": "partial", "RESOLVED": "validated"}[resolution.code]
    conn.execute(
        """INSERT INTO lexemes(lemma,pos,sense_id,gloss,source,validation_status)
                    VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(lemma,pos,sense_id)
                    DO UPDATE SET gloss=excluded.gloss,validation_status=excluded.validation_status""",
        (definition.lemma, definition.pos, definition.entry_id, definition.definition, VERSION, status),
    )
    lexeme_id = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM lexemes WHERE lemma=? AND pos=? AND sense_id=?",
        (definition.lemma, definition.pos, definition.entry_id),
    ).fetchone()[0]
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM primitive_values WHERE lexeme_id=?", (lexeme_id,))
    if resolution.code != "CONFLICT":
        conn.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO primitive_values(lexeme_id,primitive,value,source) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
            [(lexeme_id, bank, value, VERSION) for bank, value in sorted(resolution.assignments.items())],
        )
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO definition_states VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
        (
            definition.entry_id,
            lexeme_id,
            resolution.code,
            _json({b: sorted(v) for b, v in resolution.domains.items()}),
            _json(resolution.conflicts),
            _json(resolution.trace),
            _json(hierarchy),
        ),
    )
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM builder_assertions WHERE entry_id=?", (definition.entry_id,))
    conn.executemany(
        "INSERT INTO builder_assertions VALUES (?,?,?)",
        [(definition.entry_id, i, _json(asdict(a))) for i, a in enumerate(assertions)],
    )
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM builder_domain_restrictions WHERE entry_id=?", (definition.entry_id,))
    conn.executemany(
        "INSERT INTO builder_domain_restrictions VALUES (?,?,?)",
        [(definition.entry_id, i, _json(asdict(r))) for i, r in enumerate(domain_restrictions)],
    )
